description: Versions des horaires théoriques de la ligne régulière de covoiturage star't au format GTFS is a dataset listed in STAR Data Explore open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by STAR. Versions des horaires théoriques de la ligne régulière de covoiturage star't au format GTFS star't reprend les codes des transports en commun pour vous proposer un service aussi simple, pratique et fiable qu’une ligne de bus ! La différence ? STAR organise le service avec les automobilistes ! Coverage: Rennes Métropole (STAR network). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are gtfs, horaires, théoriques, star, lignes, arrêts. The portal shows 1 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2014-12-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-explore-star-fr-portal.
